The main takeaway from our work is that
public spending for institutional long-term care has the strongest impact on the chance of NFA in the last year in Europe, and that this impact is not mediated through need factors.
public expenditure on institutional long-term care is a key determinant for the utilisation of nursing home care at the end-of-life.
